indications.description: Adjuvant treatment of selected stage I, II or IIIA non-small cell lung cancer.
Locally advanced, recurrent or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.
With nivolumab for neoadjuvant treatment of resectable NSCLC at high risk of recurrence with PD-L1 expression ≥1% (3 cycles).
Adjuvant, advanced/metastatic or neoadjuvant NSCLC indications.

treatment_phases.notes: Standalone00304a/b: four21-day cycles.00304c uses the separate00849 combination and maximumthreecycles; not this four-cycle course.

gfr_ml_min.label: GFR / CrCl

gfr_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Enter the verified continuous GFR/CrCl used for carboplatin dosing. The app will apply encoded renal thresholds; confirm the Calvert calculation and local dosing policy independently.

neuropathy_grade.label: Motor or sensory neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No peripheral sensory or motor neuropathy.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only. CTCAE v5.0 grades symptomatic paraesthesia separately when that is the more accurate term.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate symptoms that limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms that limit self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening neurological consequences; urgent intervention required.

neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory and/or motor symptoms and their effect on instrumental versus self-care activities of daily living. Distinguish transient cold sensitivity from persistent functional neuropathy.

action.recommendation: Do not administer before consultant review. Prior mild carboplatin allergy may exceptionally be considered for a controlled desensitisation pathway with immunology advice; this tool does not authorise rechallenge.

rules.explanation: Relevant hypersensitivity is an exclusion.

action.recommendation: Do not administer without urgent consultant review.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding requires urgent specialist review.

action.recommendation: Withhold treatment and assess/treat the infection.

source.basis: Conservative clinical safety overlay; not a separately enumerated NCCP00304 exclusion

rules.explanation: Clinically significant infection requires safety review; this is an explicitly labelled local safety overlay.

action.recommendation: Delay treatment until count recovery.

rules.explanation: ANC 0.5 to <1.0 requires delay.

action.recommendation: Delay until recovery and consider reducing both carboplatin and paclitaxel by 25% for subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: Severe neutropenia requires delay and reduction review.

action.recommendation: Delay until recovery and consider reducing both drugs by 25% for subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: Febrile neutropenia requires delay and reduction review.

action.recommendation: Delay treatment until platelet recovery.

rules.explanation: Platelets 50 to <100 require delay.

action.recommendation: Delay until recovery and consider reducing both drugs by 25% for subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: Severe thrombocytopenia requires delay and reduction review.

action.recommendation: Do not administer carboplatin at GFR ≤20 mL/min.

rules.explanation: Carboplatin is not administered at GFR ≤20.

action.recommendation: Use carboplatin with extreme caution at GFR 20–30 mL/min.

rules.explanation: Severe renal impairment requires specialist review.

action.recommendation: Administer paclitaxel at 75% of the original dose. This is a percentage of the original dose; reconcile previous reductions and do not automatically re-escalate.

rules.explanation: Moderate bilirubin elevation requires 75% paclitaxel.

action.recommendation: Administer paclitaxel at 50% of the original dose. This is a percentage of the original dose; reconcile previous reductions and do not automatically re-escalate.

rules.explanation: Greater bilirubin elevation requires 50% paclitaxel.

action.recommendation: Do not administer paclitaxel at these hepatic values.

rules.explanation: Severe hepatic impairment is contraindicated.

action.recommendation: Reduce paclitaxel by 25%. Consultant must reconcile the original and actual dose and concurrent toxicity reductions.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 neuropathy requires paclitaxel reduction.

action.recommendation: Reduce paclitaxel by 50% because grade 2 neuropathy persists. Consultant must reconcile the original and actual dose and concurrent toxicity reductions.

rules.explanation: Persistent grade 2 neuropathy requires a larger reduction.

action.recommendation: Omit paclitaxel for grade ≥3 neuropathy.

rules.explanation: Grade ≥3 neuropathy requires paclitaxel omission.

action.recommendation: Delay until toxicity resolves to grade ≤1, then reduce both drugs by 25%. Confirm current recovery and actual dose history; do not automatically calculate a restart dose.

rules.explanation: Second grade 2 mucositis occurrence requires reduction.

action.recommendation: Delay until toxicity resolves to grade ≤1, then reduce both drugs by 50%. Confirm current recovery and actual dose history; do not automatically calculate a restart dose.

rules.explanation: Third grade 2 mucositis occurrence requires reduction.

action.recommendation: Omit carboplatin and paclitaxel after a fourth grade 2 mucositis occurrence.

rules.explanation: Repeated grade 2 mucositis requires omission.

action.recommendation: Delay until toxicity resolves to grade ≤1, then reduce both drugs by 50%. Confirm current recovery and actual dose history; do not automatically calculate a restart dose.

rules.explanation: First grade ≥3 mucositis requires 50% reduction.

action.recommendation: Omit carboplatin and paclitaxel after recurrent grade ≥3 mucositis.

rules.explanation: Recurrent grade ≥3 mucositis requires omission.

action.recommendation: Stop paclitaxel immediately, treat the severe reaction and do not rechallenge with paclitaxel; consultant review of alternatives.

rules.explanation: Severe hypersensitivity requires discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Baseline ANC below1.5 is an exclusion; distinguish this from the subsequent-cycle table.
